# MyNeS — My Network Scanner

> MyNeS (My Network Scanner) is a self-hosted, open-source application that discovers every device on your local network and manages them through a modern web interface. It combines ARP scanning, port scanning and multi-protocol discovery (mDNS/Bonjour, Matter, SSDP/UPnP, Bluetooth LE, Zigbee/Z-Wave over MQTT) with AI-assisted device identification, security/CVE analysis and Home Assistant integration. Built with Python/Flask, distributed via Docker Hub and GitHub releases. Free and MIT-licensed. Only scan networks you own.
